d: Light brown hair is pulled back into a high ponytail with loose, face-framing strands and blunt bangs. Olive-green eyes feature a sharp, determined expression on a youthful, mature face. The build is slender, dressed in a royal blue and white gown with gold trim, featuring a long white underskirt and a blue overcoat with wide sleeves and a white cowl. Accessories include a white ribbon hair tie, small gold earrings, and a glowing blue orb held between the hands.
